codelines.evidence: Located the Go-Checkout email/confirm-email validation. src/components/pages/CheckoutPage/CheckoutForm.tsx has two FormInput fields named 'email' and 'confirmEmail'. The confirmEmail field's validate rule at line 305-309 does `if (email && value && value !== email) return t("TRM774")` — a case-sensitive strict inequality check, matching the ticket's described bug (uppercase vs lowercase flagged as mismatch). TRM774 is the dictionary term linked in the ticket's documents (2.2.4 GO Dictionary of Terms Part 3#TRM774), confirming this is the exact error message referenced. Also checked CheckoutFormProvider.tsx which sets default form values (email/confirmEmail from user.email, no case transform) and confirmed the existing test file src/components/pages/CheckoutPage/__tests__/CheckoutForm.spec.tsx already has a test asserting TRM774 appears on mismatch (line 248-259), which would need an added case-insensitive-match test.

recommendedWriters.focus: Update the confirmEmail validate rule in CheckoutForm.tsx to perform a case-insensitive comparison between email and confirmEmail (e.g. normalize casing before comparing), and add/adjust unit tests in CheckoutForm.spec.tsx covering mixed-case matches (should pass) and genuine mismatches (should still show TRM774).
recommendedWriters.why: The exact comparison causing the bug (`value !== email`, case-sensitive) is pinpointed at CheckoutForm.tsx's confirmEmail validate rule, and an existing test suite already exercises this validation path, so a writer can both fix and extend coverage in one pass.
